name: What types of repairs are typically needed for a rental property turnover?

mainEntity.name: What types of repairs are typically needed for a rental property turnover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rental property repairs are practical fixes or updates to a leased dwelling between or during tenancies. Common projects include patching drywall holes, replacing broken interior doors, fixing cracked tile, touching up paint, repairing trim, and updating worn bathroom or kitchen fixtures. Landlords frequently schedule these repairs during unit turns to restore the property to move-in-ready condition. HH Remodeling handles these interior finishes directly while coordinating licensed trades for any associated plumbing or electrical punch-list items.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical rental property repairs include drywall patching, interior painting, door replacement, tile repair, and punch-list updates to kitchens and bathrooms during unit turns.
